name: Ore no Yuukyuu Koi Monogatari
source:
Kiyama Akito works a dead-end job at an exploitative company.

Never paid for overtime work and worn down by the daily grind, his crushed and burnt-out coworkers quit in quick succession.
Knowing it wouldn't be long until he ended up the same, Akito submits his resignation.

Having earned two weeks of paid leave, he considers taking a hot spring vacation to heal his mind and body. That's when he recalls his hometown in the countryside and decides to return for the first time in a decade.

However his hopes for a restful vacation are shattered when he arrives in the familiar town only to find that his planned lodging was closed for short-notice renovations! As the sun sets on our shelter-less protagonist, three women suddenly appear before him—his childhood friends, the Amakusa sisters!

After 10 years, you find yourself reunited with the Amakusa sisters.
This simple event is the start of your countryside love story.

[Taken from [url=https://qureate.co.jp/loveonleave/en/]Official English website[/url]]
translation:
归山章人在一家压榨员工的公司工作，日复一日，看不到出路。

无偿加班成了家常便饭，同事们在繁重工作中身心俱疲，精神崩溃，接连辞职。
知道自己迟早也会走到那一步，章人提交了辞呈。

终于争取到两周带薪休假的他，打算泡个温泉，疗愈身心。这时，他想起了乡下的故乡，决定时隔十年回去看看。

然而，休养的愿望刚一抵达熟悉的小镇就破灭了：原本预订的住处临时装修，无法入住！夕阳西下，无处落脚的主人公面前，忽然出现了三名女子——正是他儿时的玩伴，天草三姐妹！

时隔十年，你与天草三姐妹再次相遇。
一场看似平常的重逢，成为这段乡间恋爱故事的开端。

[摘自[url=https://qureate.co.jp/loveonleave/en/]官方英文网站[/url]]
